name: real-partner-igug-carry-cashout-20260813
description: Real IGUG partner RFT (14 rounds, 7 each) with a cash-out Farmer Carry, saved with NO exercise.sections — the structure comes from the 'Cash-out:' movement role prefix. Regression guard on four things: (1) partnerSplit 'rounds' must survive the sectioned for-time path so every row carries a TEAM total AND a ME share, (2) repairUndercountedBreakdown must not inflate the correctly-halved partner totals (35) back to team numbers (70), (3) the cash-out carry shows the team distance and the personal share, (4) the header must not restate the round count that the section title already carries.

workout.title: WOD
workout.rawText:
Movement focus of the day
Double Unders
Advanced: EMOM for 8 minutes:
"X" Double Unders (aim for ~30 sec work)
* You can also practice Triple Unders / Cross Over

METCON (Intervals)
In pairs, I go you go (the whole set):
14 RFT (7 each):
5 twin Kettlebell Snatch @12/20kg
5 twin Kettlebell Shoulder to Overhead @12/20kg
5 Burpee Box Jumps (facing)
Into:
400m Farmer Carry (I go you go)
<20 minutes T.C.>
